title: Akujo Kyousei Keikaku
titleNative: 悪女矯正計画
synonyms: Bad Girl Correction Plan
Villainess Correction Program, The Bad Girl Is Cute Today Too
synopsis: "Hey, Seraphina. When you grow up, don't kill me, okay?" The wizard Arvel meets his end at the hands of his fiancée, Seraphina, who would later become the emperor's mistress and a notorious villainess. However, when he comes to, he finds himself face-to-face with a young Seraphina! Astonishingly, he has returned to the body of his 13-year-old self. Seeing the young and still innocent Seraphina, Arvel decides he will help her become a proper lady and save his own life in the process. To start, he must find a way to prevent the death of his brother, Shou, who was once engaged to Seraphina. However, the situation is far from simple, as he must contend with Seraphina's neglectful family, other men vying for the beautiful Seraphina's attention, and a web of conflicting plots. Given a second chance, can Arvel alter Seraphina's fate and save her from becoming a villainess…!? (Source: Bushiroad, translated)

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
titleNative: 大崎さんと小森さん
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

synopsis: Finally, the moment she's been waiting for - her engagement annulment! At her graduation ceremony, villainess Sylvia is hit with the classic line from the crown prince: "I hereby annul our engagement!" To which Sylvia replies with a dazzling smile and an enthusiastic "Gladly!" Falsely accused of bullying her lover, Sylvia proves her innocence with a flawless alibi. She couldn't have bullied anyone while she was picking radishes in a dungeon! Armed with a hefty settlement for her troubles and her S-Rank adventurer's license, Sylvia retires to a quiet farm to finally live out her dream of taking it easy. But just as everything starts to go to plan, her ex-fiancé's younger brother, the second prince, shows up at her door suspecting treason and moves in with her, upending her easygoing life! A delightfully chaotic, sometimes wholesome, romantic adventure awaits! (Source: Magazine House, translated)

synonyms: I Got Sent to Another World, but It's in the Mountains. In Reaction, I Choose Comfort Over Strength.
I Got Transferred in the Middle of a Mountain. In Retaliation, I Chose Amenity over Strength.
synopsis: One summer day, Jin Konohana, a boy conscripted by his insolent sister to carry her belongings to a fireworks show, suddenly notices he is on a strange mountain. Alone in the mountains, Jin begins a life of survival. He wants to discard all troublesome things and live in peace and comfort.

title: Ochinai Yogore wo Boku wa Nanto Yobeba Yokatta noka
titleRomaji: Ochinai Yogore wo Boku wa Nanto Yobeba Yokatta noka
titleNative: 落ちない汚れを僕は何と呼べばよかったのか
synonyms: What Was I Meant to Call This Mess That Wouldn't Go Away?
synopsis: This world is filthy… Nakayama, a high school boy with an extreme case of germophobia, avoids all social interaction and tries to enjoy his private time alone in a perfectly clean space. But his peaceful days are constantly disrupted by Nishino-san, the cheerful and unpredictable girl who ends up sitting next to him. "Don’t pollute my sanctuary! Don’t intrude on my time!" Contrary to his wishes, day after day, Nakayama is at Nishino's mercy in this chatty rom-com about a germophobe and an unsophisticated high school girl!! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
